upstreamDirectives.collector: Avoid feeding duplicate candidate variants as separate repair work; group same-event stories before writing.
upstreamDirectives.clustering: Hard identity/topic mismatches must return to clustering/dossier learning, not quick rescue.
upstreamDirectives.dossierBuilder: Every repairable article needs body, knownFacts, sourcePool, and same-event evidence before editorial review.
upstreamDirectives.writer: Use the rescue lessons before drafting: no placeholder framing, no copied feed fragments, no summary repeating the body.
upstreamDirectives.headlineGenerator: Generate from dossier/body identity. Lock specific evidence-backed headlines against later generic repair overwrite.

downstreamDirectives.publishingEditor: Repair language and headline issues, but do not publish hard identity/topic mismatches.
downstreamDirectives.validator: Treat valid action verbs such as Ends, Suspends, and Withdraws as action verbs.
downstreamDirectives.publisher: Count publication only after the article is written to the public payload and visible shelf.
downstreamDirectives.rescueWorker: Process stuck articles one by one, after compaction, with a hard cap so rescue cannot starve public APIs.

rule: Stuck-rescue learning must travel upstream to collectors, clustering, dossier, writer, and headline generation, and downstream to editor, validator, publisher, and rescue worker.
